newsitem.title: UK: UK's La Senza sees loss again for year.
newsitem.headline: UK's La Senza sees loss again for year.

text.p: British retailer La Senza Plc said on Friday it expected to report a pretax loss of up to 1.6 million stg for the year compared with a loss of 1.8 million stg in the previous year.
The company attributed the loss to an expected sales shortfall for the year ending on February 1.
The company said the illustrative projections included in its prospectus had suggested break-even results for the year.
La Senza expected to post sales of about 18 million stg, up 80 percent from the previous year, but below the 21.7 million stg it estimated in its prospectus, which was published in May.
The company blamed the shortfall on later-than-expected openings at its new shops due to leasing and planning delays.
The firm opened 14 stores in the current financial year against a projection of 12.
La Senza said like-for-like sales for the month of December rose 9.8 percent compared to the year-ago period, with gross margins broadly in line with expectations.
The firm's shares were marked down 17p to 102.5p by 1110 GMT.
La Senza said it intended to open a substantial number of stores in 1997/8 but added that the precise figure would depend on commercial considerations.
The firm said it had secured nine locations so far.
